source.origin: Amazon Reviews 2023 (McAuley Lab), Electronics: up to 1,000 reviews (per-product bottom-k sample, seed 42) for each of the 50 most-reviewed products of the research sample, read from the uncompressed file on the official Hugging Face mirror by scripts/download_amazon.py --products-only. Reviews of the research sample (train/val/test) were excluded at collection time. Analytics corpus for the MCP tools only; never used for training, tuning or evaluation. Duplicates are removed at collection time by review key (user_id|parent_asin|asin|timestamp); text-based de-duplication is off because it works across the whole corpus, and two customers writing 'Works great' about two different products are distinct reviews.
